alternative.meaning: Aluminium: warm off-white ground, graphite ink, copper accent and light matte aluminium segments; the agent's recommendation. The trial starts in Anodized so the switch has to change something.

1 / PREPARE

Ada Mensah / Embedded firmware

Code meets the bench.

I’m Ada Mensah. I’m looking for embedded firmware roles involving physical devices. For Mosslink, an environmental sensor, I wrote the firmware, scheduled the power states and built the bring-up fixture.

How does a firmware decision become something you can check?

Inspect the fixture ↓
Evidence & contact
Download HTML CV

Firmware is the code that controls a physical device’s operation. Bring-up means checking a new board’s basic operation.

1 / PREPARE

A clear boundary of work.

My contribution was the firmware, power-state scheduling and bring-up fixture. My colleague designed the printed circuit board and analogue front end.

My work
Firmware · states · fixture
Colleague’s work
PCB · analogue front end

The seven segments are explanatory geometry. They do not reconstruct Mosslink, its wiring or the actual fixture.

3 / ACCESS

A decision needs a physical observation.

I built the bring-up fixture for Mosslink. Here, command, fixture access and observation are separated so you can inspect their relationship.

Command
→
Fixture access
→
Observation

Open teaching schematic ↗

This is a teaching model. Its contacts and their positions are not original wiring, probe locations or a test result.

3 / ACCESS

Mosslink, at the bench.

Mosslink is the environmental-sensor project shown here. I wrote its firmware, scheduled its power states and built its bring-up fixture.

Mosslink / project detail
↗

The project page sets out my contribution, the reported observation and the limits of the available evidence. The fixture photograph and actual current trace are unavailable.

5 / RECORD

An estimate. An observed run.

The two-year battery figure is a projection from bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. The longest continuous run was 72 hours.

PROJECTION
Two years
LONGEST RUN
72 hours

No field endurance or weather testing supports a two-year claim. The projection and the run support different claims.

5 / RECORD

Keep the scope with the result.

Forty engineering samples were assembled; six were tested on the bench. None went to customers. One preliminary emissions check passed; the full qualification programme is unfinished.

These are project counts and outcomes. They do not claim that I personally assembled or tested every sample. This was not a field pilot or a product launch.

5 / RECORD

The claim follows the observation.

A firmware decision needs a physical observation. An estimate and an observed run support different claims. That is the lesson I want to bring to firmware work involving physical devices.

A current trace showed the radio staying awake after a failed transmission. No cause, fix, timing or later resolution is confirmed. No trace file is available to publish.

1 / PrepareA clear boundary of work.My contribution was the firmware, power-state scheduling and bring-up fixture. My colleague designed the printed circuit board and analogue front end.My work Firmware · states · fixtureColleague’s work PCB · analogue front endThe seven segments are explanatory geometry. 3 / AccessA decision needs a physical observation.I built the bring-up fixture for Mosslink. 3 / AccessMosslink, at the bench.Mosslink is the environmental-sensor project shown here. I wrote its firmware, scheduled its power states and built its bring-up fixture.Mosslink / project detail ↗The project page sets out my contribution, the reported observation and the limits of the available evidence. 5 / RecordAn estimate. An observed run.The two-year battery figure is a projection from bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. The longest continuous run was 72 hours.ProjectionTwo yearsLongest run72 hoursNo field endurance or weather testing supports a two-year claim. The projection and the run support different claims.

5 / RecordKeep the scope with the result.Forty engineering samples were assembled; six were tested on the bench. None went to customers. One preliminary emissions check passed; the full qualification programme is unfinished.These are project counts and outcomes. They do not claim that I personally assembled or tested every sample. This was not a field pilot or a product launch.

5 / RecordThe claim follows the observation.A firmware decision needs a physical observation. An estimate and an observed run support different claims. That is the lesson I want to bring to firmware work involving physical devices.A current trace showed the radio staying awake after a failed transmission.
